write_rules: Read this authority from the canonical branch before Controller 2.0 work.
Re-read the canonical branch head immediately before every write.
Every write must be a non-force fast-forward from the exact head inspected by that operation.
If the canonical head changed after inspection, stop the write, reconcile the delta, and retry from the new head.
Do not create a competing Controller 2.0 branch for the same stage.
Do not merge another branch wholesale; transplant only adjudicated changes with tests.
Do not weaken an invariant or replace a failure-mode test merely to obtain green CI.
Do not modify the frozen Foundation-002 branch.
Main remains untouched until a separately qualified promotion stage authorizes it.
source_of_truth: This file selects the build line only. Runtime controller authority is the Controller 2.0 transactional store, not this Git file.
supersession_rule: A successor authority record must be an explicit reviewed change on the canonical successor branch; branch names or chat statements alone cannot supersede this authority.
